name: Jira → Slack: localized ticket status & release watcher
description: Every 15 min, finds product tickets with a "Has localization ticket" link and posts to #i18n-team when their status, fix version or version release changes.

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: issueLinkType = "Has localization ticket" AND project != INTERNAT AND (updated >= -1d OR (fixVersion in releasedVersions() AND updated >= -14d)) ORDER BY updated DESC

parameters.content:
## Localized ticket release watcher
Every 15 min: product tickets that have an INTERNAT localization ticket (link "Has localization ticket"). Posts to #i18n-team when status, fix version or version release changes. First production run only records the current state (no messages). State lives in workflow static data.

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: ={{ 'key in (' + $json.llrKeys.join(',') + ') OR ' + $json.llrKeys.map(k => 'issue in linkedIssues("' + k + '", "is tested by")').join(' OR ') }}

assignments.name: text
assignments.value: ={{ $('Detect status and release changes').item.json.text + '\nLQA status: ' + ((($json.issues || []).filter(i => $('Detect status and release changes').item.json.llrKeys.includes(i.key))).map(i => ($('Detect status and release changes').item.json.llrKeys.length > 1 ? i.key + ': ' : '') + '*' + (i.fields.customfield_11581 ? i.fields.customfield_11581.value : 'not set') + '*').join(', ') || 'unknown') + '\nLQA ticket: ' + ((($json.issues || []).filter(i => i.fields && i.fields.issuetype && i.fields.issuetype.name === 'Test Plan')).length ? $json.issues.filter(i => i.fields.issuetype.name === 'Test Plan').map(i => '<https://futuremedia.atlassian.net/browse/' + i.key + '|' + i.key + '> (' + i.fields.status.name + (i.fields.duedate ? ', due ' + i.fields.duedate : '') + ')').join(', ') : 'none yet') }}

assignments.name: replyText
assignments.value: ={{ $('Detect status and release changes').item.json.changesText + '\nLQA status: ' + ((($json.issues || []).filter(i => $('Detect status and release changes').item.json.llrKeys.includes(i.key))).map(i => '*' + (i.fields.customfield_11581 ? i.fields.customfield_11581.value : 'not set') + '*').join(', ') || 'unknown') + ' · LQA ticket: ' + ((($json.issues || []).filter(i => i.fields && i.fields.issuetype && i.fields.issuetype.name === 'Test Plan')).length ? $json.issues.filter(i => i.fields.issuetype.name === 'Test Plan').map(i => '<https://futuremedia.atlassian.net/browse/' + i.key + '|' + i.key + '> (' + i.fields.status.name + ')').join(', ') : 'none yet') }}
